title: A mediocre way for a lazy person to collect vinyl records
text:
I was excited for the surprise aspect of this club, and the fact that the first couple of albums ended up costing a bit less through this program than the record’s face value. However, after the 2nd Pink Floyd album (I don’t particularly care about Pink Floyd) and the second “greatest hits” album, I cancelled.

Anyone can buy Pink Floyd and greatest hits albums easily at any record shop. I wanted to collect or discover some music I wouldn’t have normally found or thought to try out on my own.

I think a broader collection of albums not limited to the ‘60s through ‘80s would be more up my alley. Also, it would be nice to be presented with two or three albums to choose from each month.
label: neutral
